description: 2PC coordinator crash recovery aborts transactions in PREPARED state instead of committing forward, violating atomic commit.
spec_notes: TwoPhaseRecoveryEngine must commit forward when recovering logged PREPARED transactions.

repo_files.tx_state.py:
"""2PC transaction status states."""

class TxState:
    INIT = "INIT"
    PREPARED = "PREPARED"
    COMMITTED = "COMMITTED"
    ABORTED = "ABORTED"
repo_files.participant.py:
"""2PC participant resource manager."""

from typing import Dict
from tx_state import TxState


class ParticipantRM:
    def __init__(self, rm_id: str):
        self.rm_id = rm_id
        self.prepared_txs: set[str] = set()
        self.committed_txs: set[str] = set()
        self.aborted_txs: set[str] = set()

    def prepare(self, tx_id: str) -> bool:
        self.prepared_txs.add(tx_id)
        return True

    def commit(self, tx_id: str) -> None:
        self.prepared_txs.discard(tx_id)
        self.committed_txs.add(tx_id)

    def abort(self, tx_id: str) -> None:
        self.prepared_txs.discard(tx_id)
        self.aborted_txs.add(tx_id)

tests.test_2pc_recovery.py:
from coordinator_log import CoordinatorWAL
from participant import ParticipantRM
from recovery_engine import TwoPhaseRecoveryEngine
from tx_state import TxState


def test_prepared_transaction_commits_forward_on_recovery():
    wal = CoordinatorWAL()
    p1 = ParticipantRM("rm_1")
    p2 = ParticipantRM("rm_2")
    p1.prepare("tx_100")
    p2.prepare("tx_100")
    # Coordinator logged PREPARED then crashed
    wal.write("tx_100", TxState.PREPARED, ["rm_1", "rm_2"])
    engine = TwoPhaseRecoveryEngine(wal, {"rm_1": p1, "rm_2": p2})
    res = engine.recover_all_transactions()
    assert res["tx_100"] == TxState.COMMITTED
    assert "tx_100" in p1.committed_txs
    assert "tx_100" in p2.committed_txs


def test_init_transaction_aborts_on_recovery():
    wal = CoordinatorWAL()
    p1 = ParticipantRM("rm_1")
    wal.write("tx_init", TxState.INIT, ["rm_1"])
    engine = TwoPhaseRecoveryEngine(wal, {"rm_1": p1})
    res = engine.recover_all_transactions()
    assert res["tx_init"] == TxState.ABORTED
    assert "tx_init" in p1.aborted_txs
